Company Information

This one logo is used everywhere: the app header, and the letterhead on every printed/PDF receipt (extinguisher, commission). Recommended size: 400×400px, square, PNG with a transparent background works best. Max file size 1MB.

Shown at the bottom of every printed page and receipt.

Contact & Address

Shown at the bottom of every receipt (below the note), and added automatically to the end of every WhatsApp reminder message.

The WhatsApp number shown here is the same one set below in WhatsApp Settings.

Appearance

When enabled and a logo is uploaded, the app's colors adjust to match your logo. When off, the default theme colors are used.

Signatures

Converted automatically to a transparent-background PNG and shown on every printed receipt, next to the customer's own signature.

Receipts print two signatures: the Member signature (the representative who collected the extinguishers - uploaded in that member's profile, or the default below) and the Manager signature above.

Used on the receipt only if the selected member has no signature of their own. Converted automatically to a transparent-background PNG.

Financial Settings

Used next to Rate, Price and Total on the extinguisher receipt.

Added on top of the items subtotal on the extinguisher receipt, at this percentage. Leave at 0 to hide tax on the receipt.

Commission Settings

Sets how much commission a Representative (see Members) earns for the extinguishers they collect. Applied automatically to every extinguisher receipt.

Multiplied by the total quantity of extinguishers on the receipt.

You can also set a custom commission rate for an individual member that overrides this default - see Members.

Each company can have its own base rate (and a rate card by type / per kg) in its customer record. Anything above the base goes to the representative.

Commission Price Chart

Fill this chart with your company's rates. Company rate = Fixed Rate if entered, otherwise Rate/Kg x Weight. Selling at or below the company rate = 0 commission; selling above it = the difference goes to the member as commission. If a Commission % is entered for a type, the member earns that percentage instead (only when sold above the company rate).

Backup & Restore

Save a copy of all your data (records, receipts, members, settings) to a file. Keep it somewhere safe, such as a USB drive. Restore replaces the current data with the backup file.

Your Data, Explained Plainly

Privacy Policy

How this Fire Extinguisher Management System handles the information you enter.

1. What This Policy Covers

This policy explains how customer, equipment, and staff records entered into this system are stored and used. It applies to the data you enter while using this app - fire extinguisher records, receipts, and member accounts.

2. Data We Collect

  • Customer details you enter: name, phone number, address, and equipment location
  • Fire extinguisher records: start date, validity period, and expiry status
  • Overtime and staff records you add for your own tracking
  • Company settings such as your business name and logo

3. Where Your Data Is Stored

By default, all records are stored locally on the device you use - the app does not send your data to any third party or advertising network. If a synced/cloud login (member and admin accounts) is enabled for your setup, records are stored securely in that cloud database solely so your own team can access and update them across devices - never shared outside your organization.

4. How Data Is Used

Data you enter is used only to run the features you see: showing expiry alerts, generating printable PDFs and WhatsApp messages, and building your dashboard reports. Nothing is used for advertising, and nothing is sold to third parties.

5. Your Control Over Data

You can edit or delete any record directly inside the app at any time. Since data is tied to your own device or your organization's account, you're always in control of what's kept and what's removed.

6. Contact About Privacy

Questions about how your data is handled can be sent directly to aamirjalil535@gmail.com or via WhatsApp at 0344 9004540.
